resources.string: When this is off, locks are cleared on reboot.
Turn off networks without a lock
Locking bands turns off every network without a band lock of its own. Unlocking turns them back on.
Band locks on this phone include the visible frequencies, since a bands-only lock didn\'t work here before. Tap to try the bands alone first on the next lock.
Use your wallpaper colors. Off uses the default blue theme.
A few messages from the root helper may still show up in English.
Looks for a new release on GitHub when the app starts.

string-array.name: bunny_facts
string-array.item: A rabbit\'s teeth never stop growing, so they have to keep chewing to wear them down.
A happy rabbit does a \"binky\": a jump with a twist in mid-air.
Rabbits can see almost all the way around themselves, except for a small blind spot right in front of the nose.
Rabbits can\'t vomit, so eating something bad is extra dangerous for them.
A content rabbit \"purrs\" by gently grinding its teeth.
Rabbits are most active at dawn and dusk.
Those big ears also work as radiators and help a rabbit cool down.
A group of rabbits is sometimes called a fluffle.
A thumping rabbit is warning everyone nearby that something seems off.
